name: FUN_IM_REQUEST_METRICS
description: This table tracks instrumentation metrics for individual concurrent request runs.

columns.name: METRIC_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Sequence number that provides ordering and uniqueness when a single metric can have multiple values for the same request. For example, when the instrumentation metric is child request identifier, and a Create Accounting request has multiple accounting child requests.

columns.name: INSTRUMENTED_JOB_CODE
columns.description: Code of the job that is instrumented. For example, contains XLAFSNAPRPT for the regular Create Accounting job and XLAFSNAPDST for Create Accounting for Data Set.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of request that is parent to the instrumented request. If there is no parent or the parent is unknown, the instrumented request identifier is used.

columns.name: INDEX_KEY
columns.description: Key value used to optimize common queries against this table for a particular job and metric combination. For example, application and ledger identifiers might be stored in this column so that queries can efficiently find all Create Accounting requests for a particular application and ledger combination.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
